text: dsh-background-compaction 是面向 DSH Web 的上下文压缩插件。它在 agent/pre-step 检查上下文压力，达到设定比例时把较早的对话历史交给后台任务总结，并在后续回合复用摘要。用户也可通过 /bcompact 手动启动，附带的消息会作为普通对话继续处理。设置页可调整自动触发比例、摘要模型和连续失败阈值。

dsh-background-compaction is a DSH Web context compaction plugin. It summarizes older history in the background before context pressure and reuses the summary on a later turn. Use /bcompact to start it manually; the settings page controls the trigger ratio and summary model.
想让 DSH 在上下文快满时提前后台整理较早的对话。
有没有办法让上下文压缩时当前对话不用一直等？
Can DSH summarize older conversation history in the background before context pressure forces compaction?
dsh-background-compaction 的功能「阈值前后台摘要」：在 agent/pre-step 生命周期检测上下文压力，到设定比例后后台生成较早历史的摘要，并在后续压力路径中复用已就绪结果。
dsh-background-compaction 的功能「手动后台压缩」：输入 /bcompact 可启动当前会话的后台摘要；可在命令后附消息，让该消息作为普通用户内容继续当前对话。
dsh-background-compaction 使用前须知：后台摘要会将选定对话历史交给 DSH 摘要模型处理；目标由摘要模型设置或当前对话模型决定。（见 src/host/engine.js:124-125,536-561）

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-background-compaction：> 在上下文到达阈值**之前**就把历史总结好，下一次对话直接使用摘要 —— 不卡顿、不等待。

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。它接管压缩的**触发时机**：在阈值 85% 处用一次几乎全缓存的模型调用，把"截至上一轮"的历史在后台总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界，用 **0 次模型调用**把它提交成 checkpoint。用户全程可以继续对话。

- 自动路径：到达阈值 85% 开始后台生成 → 下一回合生效
- 手动路径：`/bcompact <消息>` → 立即回答，下一回合生效
- 设置页：自动触发比例、摘要模型、失败熔断次数
- 压缩后模型看到的是：**摘要 + 上一整轮原文**

---

dsh-background-compaction README · 1. 它解决什么问题：DSH 原生压缩（`dsh-compaction-basic`）在 `agent/pre-step` 时测压 → 超过阈值 → **同步**调用一次模型写摘要 → 提交 checkpoint。这段时间用户看到的是"卡住"。

慢的不是输入（前缀命中 KV 缓存），而是**输出**。所以唯一有效的优化是：把生成挪到不需要等待的时间窗里。

本插件做的事：

```
回合 N-1（上下文到 85%）
  ├─ 原生压缩：没到阈值 → 什么都不做
  └─ 本插件：起一个游离任务，后台总结 [首节点 .. 上一轮结束]
               ↓（30~60s，用户继续对话）

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.1 自动：什么都不用做。上下文到达 `thresholdTokens × 自动触发比例` 时后台开始生成；摘要就绪后的下一个回合自动生效。

> **注意阈值的真实位置**：DSH 的 `thresholdTokens` 不是 `contextWindow × 0.8`。
> 以 200k 窗口为例：`messageBudget = 200000 - 65536`、`pressureBudget = 134464 - 65536`，
> 所以 `thresholdTokens = min(160000, 68928) = **68928**`。
> 85% 触发点是 **~58.6k**，不是 170k。本插件所有比例都相对 `thresholdTokens`，从不使用绝对 token 常量。

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.2 `/bcompact [消息]`：| 输入 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `/bcompact 继续改登录页` | 后台开始压缩；`继续改登录页` 作为普通用户消息**立即**回答；下一回合使用摘要 |
| `/bcompact` | 只触发压缩，不产生回合 |

命令跑在回合之外，所以它**不可能**同步压缩（`compactRegion` 要求 open turn）。它做的是：起后台任务 + `agent.followup(消息)`。

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.3 设置页：**设置 → 后台压缩**，三项，改完立即生效，无需重启：

| 字段 | 范围 | 说明 |

| 自动触发比例 | 0.1 – 0.99 | 达到 `thresholdTokens × 该值` 时启动后台生成，默认 0.85 |
| 摘要模型 | provider / model，或"跟随当前对话" | 默认跟随当前对话的模型 |

dsh-background-compaction README · 4. 验收：不需要长对话，三步即可：

| 步 | 操作 | 期望 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 新会话，做 2–3 轮对话（读一个文件就够，总量几百到几千 token） | 正常 |
| 2 | 输入 `/bcompact 继续` | **立即**得到回答；日志出现 `held ready` |
| 3 | 再发一条消息 | 该轮 `pre-step` 提交摘要；日志出现 `swap hit`；生成 `last-swap.json` |

> `/bcompact` 需要一个**非空且平衡**的可压缩区间（绝对下限 512 token）；历史太短会返回"历史太短，压缩没有意义"。
> 自动路径的门槛更高：被压缩区间至少是 `thresholdTokens` 的 10%（200k 窗口约 6.9k token）。

dsh-background-compaction README · 5. 它是怎么接进 DSH 的：**关键事实**：Web 版把压缩放在 **agent preset** 里，而不是宿主平面。

```yaml
section: 5. 它是怎么接进 DSH 的

text:
dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml：- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true            # 宿主平面禁用

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml：- id: compaction
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate: { compaction: true, toolResultPruner: true }
  config:
    - id: compaction-basic
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
    - id: command-compact
    - id: tool-result-pruner
```

所以每个 agent 的 `ctx.compaction` 来自 preset，并且被 `isolate` 隔离。本插件挂在**宿主平面**，通过 `agent/pre-step`（事件会冒泡到根）工作：

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml：- 它**自己**用继承来的 `compactRegion` 提交摘要 —— 不依赖自己是 agent 的 `ctx.compaction`；
- preset 里的原生引擎继续存在，作为**兜底**：摘要没赶上阈值、上下文溢出、`/compact` 都由它处理；
- 两者用同一套 `tokenMeter` 与阈值数学，所以在正常路径上原生引擎永远不会先触发。

这是有意的设计：**行为上接管压缩，同时保留一个不会出错的退路**。

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.1 覆盖了哪些方法：| 成员 | 处理 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `static Config` | 扩展 | 增加 `background` 段 |
| `constructor` | 覆盖 | 剥离 `background`、读设置、注册钩子 |
| `compactIfNeeded` | 覆盖 | pressure 分支优先用 held |
| `summarize` | 覆盖 | 指纹命中直接返回 held |
| `compactNow` | **不覆盖** | 它用 `owner: null`，而公开 `compactRegion` 要求 open turn —— 无法换入 |
| `compactRegion` | 不覆盖 | 事务逻辑必须原样 |

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.2 失效矩阵：摘要只在前缀仍然一致时使用；否则丢弃（宁可白花钱，不可用错摘要）。

| 条件 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `state !== ready` | 不换入 |
| 指纹与本次 input 不符 | `summarize` 走真实调用 |
| 路由（provider/model）变了 | 丢弃 |
| surface 首节点变了 | 丢弃 |
| 尾巴超过 `tailRatio × thresholdTokens` | 丢弃 |
| 超过 `holdTtlMs` | 丢弃 |
| 有未匹配的 `compaction/start` | 不启动新任务 |
| 未匹配的 `compaction/start` 早于 `session/end-seed` | 上个进程生命周期的陈旧标记，**不算锁** |
| 连续失败 ≥ 熔断次数 | 停止后台生成，直到 `failureCooldownMs` 后放行一次探针 |
| 换入时别的压缩占着锁（`busy`） | 摘要保留，下一个回合边界再试 |

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.2 失效矩阵：另外：任何 `compaction/start`（包括 `/compact` 与 overflow 恢复）都会**立即中止**在飞的摘要任务。

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-background-compaction：> Summarize history **before** the context hits the threshold, so the next turn can use the summary — no stall, no waiting.

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. It takes over *when* compaction happens: at 85% of the threshold it spends one nearly-fully-cached model call summarizing everything up to the previous turn in the background; at the next step boundary it commits that summary as a checkpoint with **zero model calls**. The conversation stays usable the whole time.

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-background-compaction：- Automatic: background generation starts at 85% of the threshold → applied on the next turn
- Manual: `/bcompact <message>` → answers immediately, applied on the next turn
- Settings page: auto trigger ratio, summarization model, failure circuit breaker
- After compaction the model sees: **summary + the previous turn verbatim**

---

dsh-background-compaction README · 1. The problem：DSH's built-in compaction (`dsh-compaction-basic`) measures pressure at `agent/pre-step`, and once the threshold is crossed it writes the summary **synchronously** before the turn continues. The user sees a stall.

The slow part is not the input (the prefix hits the provider KV cache) — it is the **output**. So the only effective optimization is to move generation into a window where nobody is waiting.

dsh-background-compaction README · 1. The problem：```
Turn N-1 (context reaches 85%)
  ├─ built-in compaction: below threshold → does nothing
  └─ this plugin: detached task summarizes [first node .. end of previous turn]
                    ↓ (30–60s, the user keeps chatting)

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.1 Automatic：Nothing to do. When the context reaches `thresholdTokens × autoTriggerRatio`, background generation starts; the next step boundary after the summary is ready applies it.

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.1 Automatic：> **Where the threshold really is**: DSH's `thresholdTokens` is not `contextWindow × 0.8`.
> For a 200k window: `messageBudget = 200000 - 65536`, `pressureBudget = 134464 - 65536`,
> so `thresholdTokens = min(160000, 68928) = **68928**`.
> The 85% trigger is **~58.6k**, not 170k. Every ratio in this plugin is relative to `thresholdTokens`; it never uses an absolute token constant.

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.2 `/bcompact [message]`：| Input | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `/bcompact keep going` | Background compaction starts; `keep going` is answered **immediately** as a normal user message; the next turn uses the summary |
| `/bcompact` | Triggers compaction only, no turn |

Command handlers run outside any turn, so they cannot compact synchronously (`compactRegion` requires an open turn). This command starts the detached task and calls `agent.followup(message)`.
dsh-background-compaction README · 3.3 Settings page：**Settings → Background compaction**, three fields, applied live without a restart:

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.3 Settings page：| Field | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Auto trigger ratio | 0.1 – 0.99 | Starts background generation at `thresholdTokens × ratio`; default 0.85 |
| Summarization model | provider / model, or "follow the conversation" | Defaults to the model the conversation is using |
| Failure circuit breaker | 0 – 10 | Stops background generation after this many consecutive failures; one probe is allowed after the cooldown (5 min by default) and a success clears the count |

dsh-background-compaction README · 3.3 Settings page：Settings live in `~/.dsh/background-compaction/config.json` and can be edited by hand:

```json
{
  "$schema": 1,
  "autoTriggerRatio": 0.85,
  "summarizationModel": { "provider": "", "model": "" },

**Precedence: settings file > YAML config > built-in defaults.** An empty `summarizationModel` pair means "follow the conversation".

dsh-background-compaction README · 5. How it attaches to DSH：**Key fact**: the Web app puts compaction inside **agent presets**, not the host plane.

```yaml

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml：- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true            # disabled in the host plane

dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml：- id: compaction
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate: { compaction: true, toolResultPruner: true }
  config:
    - id: compaction-basic
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
    - id: command-compact
    - id: tool-result-pruner
```

So each agent's `ctx.compaction` comes from its preset and is isolated. This plugin mounts in the **host plane** and works through `agent/pre-step` (events bubble to the root):
dsh-background-compaction README · dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml：This is deliberate: **take over compaction behaviourally, while keeping a fallback that cannot corrupt anything.**

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.1 What is overridden：| Member | Override | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `static Config` | yes | adds the `background` section |
| `constructor` | yes | strips `background`, loads settings, registers hooks |
| `compactIfNeeded` | yes | prefers a held summary on the pressure path |
| `summarize` | yes | returns the held summary on a fingerprint hit |
| `compactNow` | **no** | it runs with `owner: null`, while the public `compactRegion` requires an open turn — it cannot swap |
| `compactRegion` | no | the durable transaction must stay untouched |

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.2 Invalidation matrix：A summary is only used while the prefix still matches; otherwise it is discarded. Discarding costs one extra call — using a stale one would corrupt the model's view.

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.2 Invalidation matrix：| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| `state !== ready` | not swapped |
| fingerprint differs from this input | `summarize` performs a real call |
| routed provider/model changed | discard |
| surface head node changed | discard |
| tail exceeds `tailRatio × thresholdTokens` | discard |
| older than `holdTtlMs` | discard |
| unmatched `compaction/start` exists | do not start |
| unmatched `compaction/start` predates `session/end-seed` | stale marker from an earlier process lifecycle — **not** a lock |
| consecutive failures ≥ limit | stop background generation until `failureCooldownMs` lets one probe through |
| the swap hits another compaction's lock (`busy`) | keep the summary and retry at the next step boundary |

dsh-background-compaction README · 5.2 Invalidation matrix：In addition, any `compaction/start` (including `/compact` and overflow recovery) **aborts** an in-flight summary immediately.
